fields.Name: AIUsageByScope
fields.UserQuestion: What is our AI usage, tokens, and spend broken down by primary scope entity and record?
fields.Description: Aggregates AI usage facts by PrimaryScopeEntityID and PrimaryScopeRecordID. Supports optional filtering by scope entity, scope record, and date range.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Aggregates vwAIUsageFacts by PrimaryScopeEntityID, PrimaryScopeRecordID and CostCurrency. Runs and every measure count model calls only; parallel parents are counted separately in ParallelParents. Parameters scopeEntityId, scopeRecordId, start and end are optional (template conditionals); the window filters the base RunAt column. Latency percentiles are PERCENTILE_CONT window functions over non-parent runs, collapsed with MAX (SQL Server 2019+).
